response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_benchmark FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.film_count, r.avg_rate_per_day / b.overall_benchmark AS relative_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL
